description: Compare reference areas on one ILOSTAT dataset and one slice — a sex code plus breakdown codes, defaulting to the dataset's totals — giving each area's value at a common period or at its latest non-projected period, optional change over N years, and a rank, with each value's period, source, status, and basis (reported, modelled_estimate, or projection). Areas without a value are listed separately with the reason, and the response flags mixed periods and mixed bases rather than hiding them. Select areas by code list, by group (X01 for every country, an ILO region or subregion, or a World Bank income group), or both; X-coded aggregates require a dataset with aggregates.

area_group.description: X01 for every country, an ILO region or subregion, or a World Bank income group (X06, X56, X02, …); expands to its member countries. The group's own aggregate is compared only when listed in ref_areas. ilostat_list_reference topic area_groups lists the codes.

change_years.description: Adds each value's change from the same sub-period this many years earlier, in the dataset unit.

classif1.description: First breakdown code, case-insensitive. Defaults to the dataset's total code; required when the breakdown has no total (deciles); refused on a dataset without the breakdown. ilostat_describe_indicator lists the dataset's codes and marks its totals.

classif2.description: Second breakdown code; same defaults and rules as classif1.

dataset_id.description: One dataset ID (UNE_DEAP_SEX_AGE_RT_A), as ilostat_search_indicators returns it; case-insensitive, a DF_ prefix (the SDMX dataflow form) stripped, a bare indicator code resolved when it has one frequency.

include_projections.description: Latest mode: let projections (ILO modelled values after the cutoff) be an area's latest value.

lookback_years.description: Latest mode: an area's latest value must fall within this many years of the current year.

period.description: A common period, YYYY, YYYYQn, or YYYYMmm matching the dataset frequency (2024-Q2 and 2025-03 are normalized). Omit to compare each area at its latest period.

ref_areas.description: Reference areas (up to 300): ISO3 codes (USA) or X-coded aggregates (X01 World); case-insensitive, ILO_GEO_ forms accepted. At least one of ref_areas or area_group is required.

sex.description: Sex code SEX_T, SEX_M, SEX_F, or SEX_O; T/M/F/O and total/both/male/female/other are accepted. Defaults to SEX_T on a dataset with a sex breakdown; refused on one without.

sort.description: Row order: value_desc (default), value_asc, or ref_area. rank is always by value, highest first.

name: ilostat_compare_geographies

area_group.description: The area group and how many countries it expanded to.

best_source.description: best_source is never sent, so upstream returns the preferred source.

ref_area_count.description: Areas compared: ref_areas plus the area_group members.

time_from.description: First year sent (latest mode); no end year is sent.

attribution.description: Citation to keep with any use of the data.

cap.description: Inline preview budget, in serialized characters.

change_years.description: Years the change is measured over, when requested.

comparability.description: What makes the values more or less comparable, over every area.

modelled_estimate.description: ILO modelled estimates up to the cutoff.

projection.description: ILO modelled values after the cutoff.

reported.description: Values from a national or institutional source.

mixed_periods.description: True when the values span more than one period.

periods.description: Distinct periods of the values, newest first.

dataframe.description: The staged dataframe holding the full result; present only when staged.

evicted.description: Dataframes dropped, oldest first, to keep this tenant within 1,000,000 staged rows and 100 dataframes; present only when staging this one evicted any.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry of the staged dataframe.

name.description: Staged dataframe name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX) for ilostat_dataframe_query SQL.

dataset.description: One requested dataset and how its values are classed.

edition.description: The edition the cutoff derives from, e.g. Nov. 2025.

has_aggregates.description: Whether the dataset carries World, regional, or income-group rows.

label.description: Dataset label as ILOSTAT publishes it.

last_update.description: Last upstream update, ISO 8601 without zone offset.

projection_after_year.description: Last year counted as an estimate; modelled rows after it are classed projection.

projection_rule.description: How the cutoff was set: the label's edition, the catalog's latest ILO modelled estimates edition, or the year before the current year.

unit.description: Unit of the values, already in the multiplier scale; absent when unresolved.

measure.description: Unit code (PT percent, PS persons, LC local currency, …).

multiplier.description: Power of ten values are expressed in: 0 units, 3 thousands, 6 millions.

type.description: Unit type code (RT rate, NB number, …).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_dataset`: dataset_id is not in the catalog, or a bare indicator code has several frequencies. `unknown_code`: A ref_areas, sex, classif1, or classif2 value is not in the ILOSTAT dictionaries. `unknown_area_group`: area_group is not X01, an ILO region or subregion, or a World Bank income group. `areas_required`: Neither ref_areas nor area_group was given. `aggregates_unavailable`: An X-coded aggregate was requested from a dataset that has no aggregate rows. `invalid_slice`: A breakdown has no total code and no value was given, or sex/classif1/classif2 names a breakdown the dataset lacks. `invalid_period`: period is of a frequency other than the dataset's. `dataset_retired`: Upstream reports a catalog dataset ID as deprecated or invalid. `structure_unavailable`: classif1 or classif2 was left to its default and the ILOSTAT structure service could not supply the dataset total codes. `upstream_busy`: The server-side pacer shed the call, or the ILOSTAT API answered 429 or a challenge page. `catalog_unavailable`: No catalog snapshot has loaded and the load failed, or the first load has not finished within 30 s. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

include_projections.description: Whether a projection could be an area's latest value.

legend.description: Labels for the status flags and note codes in rows.

notes.description: Note code → label, for every note code in rows.

obs_status.description: Observation status code → label, for every status flag in rows.

missing.description: Requested areas with no value, and why.

reason.description: no_value_in_window (latest mode), no_value_for_period (period mode), or not_covered (absent from the dataset's area list; never given when that list is unavailable, which notice says).

mode.description: latest: each area's latest value; period: every area at one period.

notice.description: Mixed periods, mixed bases, missing areas, a unit or area list the structure service could not supply, where the full comparison is staged, or why the inline rows stop early.

rows.description: Areas with a value, in the requested order; the staged dataframe holds all when larger.

change.description: Change over change_years; absent when the earlier value is missing.

delta.description: value − from_value, in the dataset unit.

from_value.description: The value at the earlier period.

rank.description: Rank by value, highest first; ties share a rank.

slice.description: The one series compared per area.

defaulted.description: Which slice codes were filled from the dataset's totals.

truncated.description: True when the inline rows stop before the last area — also when a dataframe holds the full comparison.

window_from.description: Latest mode: the first year requested — lookback_years before the current year, and change_years further back to reach the change base. A latest value still falls within lookback_years.

title: Compare areas on an ILOSTAT dataset
